_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); beverage and convenient-food signals

pit_profile.why: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food and beverage company with a complementary portfolio of enjoyable brands, including Frito-Lay, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Quaker and Tropicana'; 'Our beverage, food and snack products are in highly competitive categories and markets', 'In 2017, we and The Coca-Cola Company represented approximately 23% and 20%, respectively, of the U.S. liquid refreshment beverage category by estimated retail sales in measured channels', and 'However, The Coca-Cola Company has significant carbonated soft drink (CSD) share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2017 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: PepsiCo's own FY2017 10-K says 'The loss of, or a significant reduction in sales to, any key customer or disruption in the retail landscape, including rapid growth in hard discounters and the e-commerce channel, could adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations.' At the same time it sells through e-commerce itself: 'Our products are also available on a growing number of e-commerce websites and mobile commerce applications as consumer consumption patterns continue to change and retail increasingly expands online.'. The stock trades at 31.1x FY18E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ECOMMERCE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing the shift away from physical retail into PepsiCo's own sales specifically.

classification.quality_note: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food and beverage company with a complementary portfolio of enjoyable brands, including Frito-Lay, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Quaker and Tropicana'; 'Our beverage, food and snack products are in highly competitive categories and markets', 'In 2017, we and The Coca-Cola Company represented approximately 23% and 20%, respectively, of the U.S. liquid refreshment beverage category by estimated retail sales in measured channels', and 'However, The Coca-Cola Company has significant carbonated soft drink (CSD) share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2017 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +95% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.86; conservative 2yr -28%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -22.5%/yr (worst year FY08-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +4.7%/yr (Q3 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +4.7%/yr (FY08-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +10.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PEP (retrospective, 2018-10-12) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (69.6% downside to Bear $32 / +-8.8% upside to Bull $96) | Adj composite 1.91 vs market 3.77: gap -1.86 [OVERVALUED] | +95% above the EPP floor $54 (16x FY18E $3.38) | Conservative 2-yr case: -28.4% total (-14.2%/yr) | At 31.1x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $139 sits above the BULL case; servings +3.0% in Q3 2018, forward revenues +3.5% (Q3 2018 net revenue ex-currency); e-commerce is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
